video.title: I Tried Google AI Ultra. Here’s Why I Downgraded
video.description:
I tried Google AI Ultra and downgraded. In this video I explain why, what I still use Google AI Pro for, the Claude cloud-credit surprise I ran into, and how I choose between the AI tools I actually use for game development and everyday work.

These are my own experiences, recorded October 26, 2026. Prices, promotions, features and usage limits can change and can differ by account or region. The Claude credit and expiry shown belong to my account; check your own Usage page. The project behaviour is what I observed, not a promise about every account.

The Gemini API CLI discussion references “Gemini API CLI + Claude Code: Give Your Agent Video, Voice & Music” by AI with Surya, shown in my screen recording.

Which AI plan has been worth it for your own work? Let me know in the comments.
